title: About Me
text:
Aviv Alvian Nur
Senior Statistician @ Statistics Indonesia (BPS)
I am a statistician and data scientist specializing in socio-economic data analysis and machine learning. Currently, I work at Statistics Indonesia (BPS) where I design national surveys and provide data-driven insights for policymakers.

Education

M.S. in Data Science, Worcester Polytechnic Institute (GPA 3.91)
B.A.S. in Statistics, Sekolah Tinggi Ilmu Statistik (GPA 3.59)



Technical Arsenal

Languages: Python, R, SQL.
Tools: Tableau, Git, QGIS, SPSS, Microsoft Excel.
Expertise: Machine Learning, Big Data Analytics, Econometrics, and Sampling Methods.
